excerpt: Bold typographic digital flagship with kinetic hover cards, holographic gradients, and fluid layout.

data.tagline: Bold typographic digital flagship with kinetic hover cards, holographic gradients, and fluid layout.
data.author: Pixoptimo Labs
data.techStack: HTML5, Modern CSS, CSS Custom Properties, Fluid Typography, Hardware-Accelerated Transitions
data.features:
Avant-garde Syne typography with fluid clamp() scaling from 48px to 110px
Dynamic holographic CSS gradient reflections on card hover
Refined micro-stagger animations for project cards
Zero JavaScript dependency footprint — 100% pure CSS motion
Full dark mode aesthetic with obsidian ink backgrounds
Mobile-first responsive drawer menu and smooth scroll anchors
